summary: The vendor, wireless, filesystem and device-protocol unit. Most of its externals are owned units; the remaining seam is the stock USB/wireless and filesystem surface.

rows.kind: C-ABI bridge between two owned units
rows.removal: each caller links the owning crate directly and both sides compare with stock in one image

evidence.requirement: The registered mechanism belongs to the component/runtime composition, not the bounded session-native ELF. No produced production ELF establishes this boundary. `xm1_app_nand_*`, `xm1_power_*`, `xm1_scanout_*`, `xm1_rtos_own_first_slot_*` externs (owned units)

rows.removal: every USB/session caller is owned or migrated

evidence.requirement: USB task and interrupt exports remain component declarations without an existing produced production ELF.
The bounded native session image retains the session control entry through vendor_session_probe; USB task and interrupt publication are not established by this qualification image.

rows.other_side: stock wireless driver and supplicant tasks

evidence.requirement: The registered mechanism belongs to the component/runtime composition, not the bounded session-native ELF. No produced production ELF establishes this boundary. `xm1_wireless_driver_task`, `xm1_wireless_supplicant_task` retained services

rows.other_side: retained stock filesystem, media and metadata services
rows.removal: the owned file service and filesystem are qualified

evidence.requirement: The registered mechanism belongs to the component/runtime composition, not the bounded session-native ELF. No produced production ELF establishes this boundary. filesystem and media-task ABI views (`filesystem_*`, `media_parser`, `metadata_*`)
